rav-nachman.name: Rav Naḥman
rav-nachman.bio: Rav Naḥman bar Ya’akov, a leading judge of Neharde’a and student of Shmuel, linked by marriage to the Exilarch’s family.
rav-nachman.prompt: A confident, authoritative judge in his 50s with a full dark beard going grey, in fine layered robes befitting a man connected to the Exilarch’s household, seated as if hearing a case, background mudbrick court walls of Neharde’a lit by oil lamps.

rav-dimi.name: Rav Dimi
rav-dimi.bio: A Babylonian Amora who carried teachings from the Land of Israel back to Babylonia.
rav-dimi.prompt: A travel-worn scholar in his 40s with a short brown beard and an alert, attentive face, a satchel strap across his travel cloak as one who brought teachings from the Land of Israel to Babylonia, background a road with palm trees fading into Babylonian mudbrick walls.

rabbi-yonatan.name: Rabbi Yonatan
rabbi-yonatan.bio: An early Amora of the Land of Israel, often cited by later sages.
rabbi-yonatan.prompt: A thoughtful elder sage in his 60s with a grey beard and a gentle, steady gaze, in a simple wool mantle with a scroll in his hands, background Galilean limestone arches and olive trees.
